title: Is Jaden Smith dating 82-year-old Michele Lamy or are the viral pics AI?

 Goodlife Is Jaden Smith dating 82-year-old Michele Lamy or are the viral pics AI?
 By Sanjali Brahma 
 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 8:30PM | 1 min read Jaden Smith and Michele Lamy
 Advertisement Social media has been abuzz with an unlikely celebrity romance involving Hollywood actor and musician Jaden Smith and French fashion personality Michele Lamy. The speculation, which has drawn attention to the 54-year age gap between the two, has sparked widespread claims of a possible relationship and even an alleged engagement. However, the rumours are false, with no credible evidence to suggest that the two are romantically involved.
 The 28-year-old son of Hollywood stars Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith was recently linked to Lamy, 82, after a series of posts began circulating online. What reportedly started as claims that Smith had visited the fashion personality to seek her blessings soon escalated into speculation about an engagement. Some social media posts even alleged that Lamy had promised to leave 80 per cent of her property holdings to the actor.
 Advertisement 
 The chatter gained further momentum after purported photographs and videos of the two sharing intimate moments, holding hands and kissing surfaced online. One viral Instagram post particularly drew attention to their considerable age difference, adding to the frenzy surrounding the alleged romance.
 Advertisement However, some of the photographs and videos circulating online are fabricated and appear to have been generated using artificial intelligence. Neither Smith nor Lamy has confirmed any romantic involvement or engagement. Moreover, Lamy is married to celebrated American fashion designer Rick Owens, making the viral relationship claims particularly misleading. There is also no verified evidence supporting the claim about her supposedly promising Smith a share of her property holdings.
 Lamy is a French fashion entrepreneur, artist and performer who has carved out a distinct identity in the international fashion and art scene. While she is widely recognised for her creative and personal partnership with Owens, she has also established herself as an influential figure in her own right. The duo first crossed paths professionally in the 1990s, when Lamy hired Owens to work on patterns for her fashion business. Their professional association gradually developed into a personal relationship, and the two married in 2006. Together, they went on to establish Owenscorp, a creative business spanning fashion, furniture and other design ventures.
 While the viral posts have generated considerable curiosity, the alleged romance between Jaden Smith and Michele Lamy remains an internet hoax rather than a confirmed celebrity relationship.
